title: Rabbi David Tawil: Understanding the Amida- Birkat Kohanim (Part 2)- "A Kohen Hazzan"

chapters.title: Preparation for Birkat Kohanim
chapters.about: Procedures before the blessing including hand washing and the Kohen's prayer

chapters.title: The Procedure of the Blessing
chapters.about: Tallit usage, prompting the Kohanim, and the role of the chazzan

chapters.title: A Kohen as Chazzan
chapters.about: Rules for when a Kohen is leading the repetition of the Amidah

chapters.title: Fathers Blessing Children
chapters.about: Customs and sources regarding fathers and sons during the blessing

chapters.title: Conduct of the Kahal
chapters.about: Focusing on the blessing and avoiding distractions or extra prayers

summary: Rabbi Tawil explains the procedure for Birkat Kohanim during the repetition of the Amidah, including the prayer recited by Kohanim before the blessing and the role of the chazzan in prompting them. He also addresses the halacha regarding a Kohen serving as chazzan, the custom of fathers blessing their children during this time, and the proper conduct for the kahal while receiving the blessing.
questions: What prayer do Kohanim say before performing Birkat Kohanim?
Should a Kohen who is the chazzan participate in Birkat Kohanim?
Is there a source for fathers blessing their children during Birkat Kohanim?
What should the kahal do while the Kohanim are reciting the blessing?
Is it permitted to recite other prayers or verses during Birkat Kohanim?
